title: Broken counter reset
prompt: Write class Counter with increment() adding 1, value() returning the count, and reset() returning the count to zero. Instances start at zero.
hidden_tests: c = Counter(); c.increment(); c.increment(); assert c.value() == 2
c = Counter(); c.increment(); c.reset(); assert c.value() == 0
c = Counter(); c.increment(); c.reset(); c.increment(); assert c.value() == 1
a = Counter(); b = Counter(); a.increment(); assert b.value() == 0
teacher_lesson: In reset(), assign zero to the same attribute that value() reads; a new attribute name leaves the old count untouched.

mock.label: MOCK — scripted student, not a model
